timing: before model implementation, synthetic tests, GPU smoke, formal training, or new validation access
reason: freeze feature taps, recursive level semantics, MSE reduction, paired bootstrap procedure and parent evidence hashes

base_voxel_kd_exact_contract.voxel_kl: student binary logits cat([0,z_s])/T -> log_softmax; teacher binary logits cat([0,z_t])/T -> softmax; F.kl_div(reduction=none).sum(channel).mean(all voxels)*T^2; T=2
base_voxel_kd_exact_contract.teacher_blend: under no_grad bfloat16 forwards, cast history and EMA logits to float32, then z_t=0.75*z_history+0.25*z_EMA
base_voxel_kd_exact_contract.optimizer: torch.optim.AdamW student parameters, lr from frozen late-cosine, weight_decay=1e-5, betas=[0.9,0.999], eps=1e-8, amsgrad=false
base_voxel_kd_exact_contract.augmentation: existing augment_batch max_shift=8 with global RNG reset after all model/module construction

recursive_wavelet_levels.next_level_input: previous level subband index0 LLL coefficients
recursive_wavelet_levels.within_stage: arithmetic mean of the three level losses
recursive_wavelet_levels.across_stages: direct sum of four stage losses
recursive_wavelet_levels.paper_code_boundary: paper describes one l-level detail projection; official runtime recursively feeds each prior LLL, reconstructs each level separately, then means three losses; project freezes official runtime semantics

student_ema_source_deviation: released BraTS config use_ema=true applies EMA to the student for validation/checkpointing; project deliberately keeps student EMA=false so the only change from archived base voxel-KD is DCD

frozen_db4_coefficients.runtime_dtype: convert one-dimensional taps to torch.float32 before constructing the 3D bank
frozen_db4_coefficients.bank_construction: for z,y,x in [lo,hi] with lo before hi, take separable outer product, stack eight kernels and unsqueeze channel to contiguous [8,1,8,8,8] float32 CPU tensor

gradient_audit_unit: for each stage i separately call autograd.grad(raw_stage_loss_i, captured_student_feature_i); require gradient present, finite, and norm>0; do not substitute total encoder-parameter gradient
reload_gate_scope: all four saved checkpoints strict-load into plain AutomaticPromptLocator and reproduce their deploy logits exactly; validation-selected checkpoint receives an additional reload audit

gpu_smoke_timing.measurement: CUDA synchronize immediately before and after each complete forward+loss+backward+clip+optimizer step; median measured seconds

paired_bootstrap.scan_unit: 108 paired case deltas, resample 108 indices with replacement per draw
paired_bootstrap.subject_unit: first mean case Dice within each of 50 subjects, then form paired subject deltas and resample 50 indices with replacement per draw
